main.description: A titled discussion thread, such as a forum thread or a chat channel. Written by its author. Forked from site.standard.document, but only as a container: it holds the title and where the thread lives, and has no body. Every message in it is a community.lexicon.thread.post, including the opening post (OP), which is the thread author's first post in it that answers no other post. A thread can have no OP, such as a channel whose chat is just its posts.

group.description: The group the thread belongs to: a community.lexicon.thread.group (at://), or the group's URL (https://) for a loose thread.

path.description: Combine with the publication url to build the thread's canonical URL. Starts with a slash.

parent.description: The thread this one lives in, such as the channel a forum thread was posted to. Absent for a top-level thread, which a forum can feature as a channel with community.lexicon.thread.channel.

description.description: A short summary written by the author. When it's absent, clients show the start of the opening post's textContent instead: up to 300 characters and at most 3 paragraphs.

updatedAt.description: When the author last edited the title or description. Not the time of the latest post, which indexers derive from posts.
